title: A/H强势宽度与政策流动性托底，贵金属领涨但电气设备与油气链承压
summary: 11月4日A/H市场普涨，隔夜美股白银、黄金领涨，油气、电气设备和独立电力领跌；林洋能源、友讯达与汽车之家列条件关注，统一股份列回避。

关键词云图

贵金属领涨 A股宽度修复 电气设备背离 流动性操作 消费基建 数据要素 电网订单 冷却液框架风险 汽车之家分红 业绩下滑 油价急跌 AKShare时点
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美国中期选举后风险资产反弹、油价急跌
民主党赢得国会两院后，政治不确定性下降，标普500、纳指和道指分别收涨1.58%、1.44%和3.04%；Brent跌8.7%至94.62美元。油价回落缓解运输和下游成本，但AI监管与中东谈判仍会制造波动。来源：Reuters转载、Reuters。
排行
贵金属领涨，能源、电气设备与独立电力领跌
11月4日美股现金时段，白银+10.19%、黄金+8.98%、其他贵金属+8.54%；油气炼制-6.09%、油气钻探-7.23%、电气设备-8.61%、独立电力-9.06%。A/H贵金属映射偏强，但电网订单需面对海外行业负反馈。来源：GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照，08:36 CST。
政策
央行将开展3000亿元买断式逆回购
人民银行公告11月5日开展3000亿元3个月期买断式逆回购；相对11月5000亿元到期量为缩量续作，操作意在维持流动性充裕并避免市场把机制改革误读为降息。对高估值成长股是流动性缓冲，而非无条件扩张信号。来源：央行公告报道。
政策
消费基础设施指导意见覆盖充电、冷链和数字化
五部门指导意见要求补齐停车与充电设施、冷链物流、智慧商圈和消费终端数字化等短板，并引导政策性金融工具、REITs与社会资本参与。利好充电、电网、冷链和数字商业设施，但项目落地和回报周期需核验。来源：国家发展改革委。
政策
数据要素与人工智能用数治理继续推进
国家数据局提出建设全国一体化数据市场、推进新一轮“数据要素×”行动，并研究AI用数安全与合规指引。对数据基础设施、行业数据服务和AI应用是中期支撑，短期仍以真实订单和价格确认为准。来源：国家数据局。
产业
5G+工业互联网大会聚焦AI融合赋能
2026中国5G+工业互联网大会将于11月18日至20日在武汉举行，聚焦人工智能融合赋能并计划发布相关成果。事件提升工业互联网与通信设备关注度，但会议预期不能替代公司订单。来源：人民邮电报转载。
市场
A/H指数与A股宽度同步修复
11月4日上证、创业板、恒指和恒科分别上涨2.16%、6.40%、1.67%和1.77%。AKShare 14:23快照显示A股4682涨/769跌/122平、中位数+1.82%，港股1027涨/659跌/1113平、中位数0%；这是盘中基线而非完整收盘。
公告
林洋能源中标国家电网项目约1.99亿元
公司收到智能电表、采集终端等7个标包及智能融合终端中标通知，合计约1.988亿元，占2025年营收4.08%；尚未签正式合同。11月4日收盘5.70元、涨4.40%，价格早于盘后公告。来源：公司公告转录。
公告
友讯达中标国家电网项目约1.96亿元
公司合计中10个包，金额约1.956亿元，占2025年营收24.56%；合同尚未正式签署。11月4日收盘8.87元、涨0.68%，而前三季度归母净利润仍亏损411.6万元，催化与盈利质量并存冲突。来源：公司公告转录。
公告
统一股份与宁德时代签署冷却液战略合作
双方拟开展冷却液全生命周期、可靠性和汽车后市场合作，但协议没有采购量、金额、最低采购义务，对本年度业绩预计不构成重大影响。公司11月4日收盘18.18元、跌6.86%，且单三季度亏损487.98万元。来源：公司公告转录。
业绩
汽车之家收入与利润下滑，但高股息获ADR正反馈
三季度收入13.15亿元、同比下降26.0%，归母净利润1.95亿元、同比下降55.3%；董事会批准每ADS 1.58美元现金股息，全年已宣布股息约15亿元。ATHM收涨12.63%至22.49美元，港股11月4日收38.92港元且交易早于业绩。来源：公司公告。
产业
国家电网智能计量订单集中落地
除林洋与友讯达外，炬华科技亦披露约2.36亿元中标，显示智能电表和融合终端采购进入兑现期。订单利好本地设备链，但隔夜美股电气设备行业跌8.61%，今日只能做公司级确认而非板块追涨。来源：炬华科技公告转录。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
三大ETF代理保持普涨
运行时公开报价截至08:21-08:23 CST：QQQ 691.95美元、较前收+0.96%；SPY 766.81美元、+1.63%；DIA 533.11美元、+3.09%。三者是延长时段ETF代理，涨跌为相对前收的累计变化，数据源未拆分收盘后单独增量。
板块对照
贵金属与概念强势获确认，弱势行业代表股分化
行业Top5代表股NEWP +14.67%、NAMM +12.92%、HL +13.17%、LDI +15.19%、ADV +35.09%，均确认正向。Bottom5中BORR -3.90%确认油气钻探弱势；AIOK +11.31%、OFAL +12.34%、ZOOZ +14.72%、ONEN +6.62%与所属负向行业相反，属于个股背离/潜在反转。概念Top5的MOS +17.32%、HL +13.17%、OUST +15.73%、DFDV +14.42%、CCL +7.23%均确认正向。报价时间跨06:35-08:23 CST。
A/H 映射
贵金属延续但电网订单需逆风确认
白银、黄金强势叠加A股11月4日贵金属上涨，支持相关资源股情绪延续；但电气设备隔夜跌8.61%，与林洋、友讯达中标催化相冲突。今日只在候选守住11月4日收盘价且板块不显著转弱时保留条件关注；油价急跌利好运输和下游成本，却不支持油气链追涨。

盘前结论

A/H在11月4日出现广泛修复，贵金属与科技弹性明显；流动性操作、消费基础设施和数据政策继续提供中期支撑。

隔夜电气设备、独立电力和油气链显著下跌；国内电网中标虽有公司催化，但不能无视海外行业负反馈。

策略采用事件与价格双确认：林洋能源、友讯达、汽车之家列条件关注；统一股份因框架无金额、单季亏损和负面价格表现列回避。贵金属、超导、激光雷达和SOL主题未核验出新增公司级依据，不硬凑推荐。

重点个股关注

林洋能源
601222.SH
条件关注

事实与状态：国家电网中标约1.988亿元，占2025年营收4.08%；11月4日收5.70元、涨4.40%，价格早于盘后公告。

确认条件：开盘后守住5.70元并相对电气设备板块转强，且正式合同推进。

风险与失效：尚未签正式合同，交付与收入确认不确定；跌回5.46元前收附近且板块继续走弱则失效。

友讯达
300514.SZ
条件关注

事实与状态：国家电网中标约1.956亿元，占2025年营收24.56%；11月4日收8.87元、涨0.68%，前三季度归母净利润亏损411.6万元。

确认条件：开盘放量站稳8.87元，合同签署与回款安排清晰，且电网设备不出现集体回落。

风险与失效：合同未签、盈利仍弱；跌破11月4日低点8.54元或无量冲高回落即降级。

汽车之家-S
02518.HK / ATHM
条件关注

事实与状态：三季度收入和归母利润同比下降约26%和55%，但每ADS 1.58美元股息与回购支撑估值，ATHM收涨12.63%；港股38.92港元报价早于业绩。

确认条件：港股开盘跟随ADR正反馈并守住11月4日收盘价，成交量放大且不出现明显折价。

风险与失效：广告、线索和车市交易收入均承压；港股不跟随ADR或高开低走则降级。

统一股份
600506.SH
回避

事实与状态：与宁德时代合作仅为框架协议，没有数量、金额或最低采购义务；11月4日收18.18元、跌6.86%，单三季度亏损487.98万元。

确认条件：仅在出现具体订单、金额和交付计划，并重新站上18.18元后重评。

风险与失效：高估值、单季亏损、框架不确定及隔夜油气炼制-6.09%共同构成压力，当前不具备多头条件。

板块轮动看板

受益方向白银、黄金及其他贵金属；消费基础设施、数据要素的中期政策线索
观察方向智能电表/融合终端订单、汽车之家高股息；必须取得本地开盘确认
压力方向油气炼制与钻探、电气设备、独立电力；统一股份框架协议风险
验证信号贵金属不出现冲高回落；林洋守5.70元、友讯达守8.87元、汽车之家港股跟随ADR

逻辑链

央行流动性操作 + 消费基础设施政策 → 资金与项目端缓冲 → 支持A/H结构机会但不等于全面追涨。
A股强宽度 + 创业板涨6.40% → 本地风险偏好修复 → 允许科技与资源主题延续观察。
白银/黄金行业领涨且代表股同向 → 贵金属趋势获海外确认 → 但缺新增公司催化，不生成个股推荐。
电气设备-8.61% + 国内电网中标 → 海外行业与本地公告冲突 → 林洋、友讯达仅列条件关注。
汽车之家盈利下滑 + 高股息与ADR大涨 → 基本面和价格反馈分化 → 等港股开盘确认，不直接看多。

风险雷达

选举与监管美国政治变化可能提高AI、数据中心和金融监管不确定性。
行业背离电气设备与独立电力隔夜重挫，可能压制国内电网设备催化。
公告执行林洋、友讯达合同尚未正式签署；统一股份协议无金额和最低采购量。
业绩分化汽车之家收入和利润下滑，ADR上涨主要受分红与回购支撑。
数据时效AKShare是11月4日14:23盘中快照；ETF代理为相对前收累计变化。

数据来源与时间点

研究截止2026-11-05 08:40 CST。国内政策来源：人民银行公告报道、国家发展改革委、国家数据局；公司披露：上交所/巨潮公告转录及HKEX/公司IR。美股：Reuters及GitHub Actions/Moomoo快照，快照于2026-11-05 08:36 CST完成并覆盖11月4日现金时段。ETF代理和代表股报价于08:38-08:40 CST查询，底层报价时间06:35-08:23 CST。AKShare v1.18.94 fetchedAt 2026-11-04 14:23:57 CST，A股marketDate=2026-11-04、marketPhase=intraday_snapshot、calendarVerified=true：4682涨/769跌/122平，中位涨幅+1.82%；港股1027涨/659跌/1113平，中位涨幅0%。该快照只作11月4日盘中基线，不冒充完整收盘。

Keyword Cloud

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.
Major News Digest
Global
Risk assets rally and oil tumbles after US midterms
After Democrats won both chambers of Congress, political uncertainty eased; the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow rose 1.58%, 1.44% and 3.04%. Brent fell 8.7% to $94.62. Lower oil helps transport and downstream costs, while AI regulation and Iran talks remain volatility risks. Sources: Reuters mirror and Reuters.
Ranking
Precious metals lead; energy and electrical equipment lag
In the Nov 4 US cash session, silver rose 10.19%, gold 8.98% and other precious metals 8.54%. Refining fell 6.09%, drilling 7.23%, electrical equipment 8.61% and independent power 9.06%. A/H precious metals map positively, but local grid awards face overseas sector pressure. Source: GitHub Actions/Moomoo snapshot at 08:36 CST.
Policy
PBOC schedules CNY300 billion outright reverse repo
The PBOC will conduct CNY300 billion of three-month outright reverse repos on Nov 5. Against CNY500 billion maturing in November, this is a smaller rollover intended to keep liquidity ample without implying an unconditional rate cut. Source: PBOC notice report.
Policy
Consumption-infrastructure guidance covers charging, cold chain and digitization
Five ministries called for upgrades to parking and charging networks, cold-chain logistics, smart commercial districts and digital consumption terminals, with policy finance, REITs and private capital participation. Projects and return cycles still require verification. Source: NDRC.
Policy
Data-element and AI data-governance plans advance
The National Data Administration proposed an integrated national data market, a new Data Elements Plus program and AI-data compliance guidance. This supports data infrastructure and industry-data services over the medium term, but near-term trades still need orders and price confirmation. Source: NDA.
Industry
5G + Industrial Internet conference focuses on AI enablement
The 2026 China 5G + Industrial Internet Conference will be held in Wuhan on Nov 18-20 and plans to release AI-integration results. This lifts attention to industrial internet and telecom equipment, but conference expectations do not replace company orders. Source: People's Posts and Telecommunications News mirror.
Market
A/H indexes and A-share breadth rebound together
On Nov 4, Shanghai, ChiNext, Hang Seng and HSTECH rose 2.16%, 6.40%, 1.67% and 1.77%. AKShare's 14:23 snapshot showed 4,682 A-share advancers/769 decliners/122 flat with a +1.82% median; Hong Kong showed 1,027/659/1,113 with a 0% median. This is an intraday baseline, not the full close.
Filing
Linyang wins about CNY199 million of State Grid projects
The company received awards for seven smart-meter and collection-terminal packages plus an intelligent terminal package, totaling CNY198.834 million or 4.08% of 2025 revenue; formal contracts are unsigned. The Nov 4 close was CNY5.70, up 4.40%, before the after-hours filing. Source: filing transcript.
Filing
Youxunda wins about CNY196 million of State Grid projects
The company won ten packages totaling CNY195.616 million, or 24.56% of 2025 revenue; contracts remain unsigned. The Nov 4 close was CNY8.87, up 0.68%, while nine-month attributable profit was still a CNY4.12 million loss. Source: filing transcript.
Filing
Tongyi signs a coolant cooperation framework with CATL
The parties plan lifecycle, reliability and aftermarket cooperation, but the framework has no purchase volume, value or minimum commitment and is not expected to materially affect this year's results. The stock closed Nov 4 at CNY18.18, down 6.86%, while Q3 alone recorded a CNY4.88 million loss. Source: filing transcript.
Earnings
Autohome earnings fall but dividend wins positive ADR feedback
Q3 revenue fell about 26% to CNY1.315 billion and attributable profit about 55% to CNY195 million. The board approved a $1.58-per-ADS cash dividend; declared 2026 dividends total about CNY1.5 billion. ATHM rose 12.63% to $22.49, while the HK$38.92 Hong Kong close preceded results. Source: company release.
Industry
State Grid smart-meter awards arrive in a cluster
Beyond Linyang and Youxunda, Juhua disclosed about CNY236 million of awards, confirming procurement momentum in smart meters and integrated terminals. The local order cycle is positive, but US electrical equipment fell 8.61%, so today's setup requires company-level confirmation rather than a sector chase. Source: Juhua filing transcript.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight Indexes
Three ETF proxies remain broadly positive
Runtime public quotes at 08:21-08:23 CST: QQQ $691.95, +0.96% versus the prior close; SPY $766.81, +1.63%; DIA $533.11, +3.09%. These are extended-hours ETF proxies with cumulative changes versus the prior close; the source does not isolate a standalone post-close leg.
Sector Check
Precious metals and concepts confirm; weak-industry leaders diverge
Industry Top5 leaders NEWP +14.67%, NAMM +12.92%, HL +13.17%, LDI +15.19% and ADV +35.09% confirm positive direction. In Bottom5, BORR -3.90% confirms drilling weakness; AIOK +11.31%, OFAL +12.34%, ZOOZ +14.72% and ONEN +6.62% oppose their negative industries, signaling stock-level divergence/potential reversal. Concept leaders MOS +17.32%, HL +13.17%, OUST +15.73%, DFDV +14.42% and CCL +7.23% all confirm positive direction. Quote times span 06:35-08:23 CST.
A/H Mapping
Precious metals persist while grid orders need confirmation against headwinds
Silver and gold strength, alongside the Nov 4 A-share precious-metals rally, supports continued resources sentiment. Yet US electrical equipment fell 8.61%, conflicting with Linyang and Youxunda award catalysts. Keep conditional watches only if candidates hold their Nov 4 closes and the local group avoids sharp weakness. The oil slump helps transport and downstream costs but does not support chasing energy names.

Pre-market Conclusion

A/H markets posted broad repair on Nov 4, led by high-beta technology and precious metals. Liquidity operations, consumption infrastructure and data policy provide medium-term support.

US electrical equipment, independent power and oil chains fell sharply. Domestic grid awards are company catalysts, but the overseas negative sector signal cannot be ignored.

Use event-plus-price confirmation: Linyang, Youxunda and Autohome are conditional watches; Tongyi is an avoid because the framework has no value, Q3 was loss-making and price action was negative. No stock pick is manufactured from precious metals, superconductors, lidar or SOL without new company-level evidence.

Key Stocks

Linyang Energy
601222.SH
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: State Grid awards total CNY198.834 million, 4.08% of 2025 revenue. The Nov 4 close was CNY5.70, up 4.40%, before the filing.

Confirmation: Hold CNY5.70 after the open, outperform electrical equipment and advance formal contracts.

Risk and invalidation: Contracts are unsigned and delivery/revenue timing is uncertain. A drop toward the CNY5.46 prior close with sector weakness invalidates the setup.

Youxunda
300514.SZ
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: State Grid awards total CNY195.616 million, 24.56% of 2025 revenue. The Nov 4 close was CNY8.87, up 0.68%; nine-month attributable profit was a CNY4.12 million loss.

Confirmation: Hold CNY8.87 on volume, clarify contract signing and collections, and avoid a broad grid-equipment reversal.

Risk and invalidation: Contracts are unsigned and profitability is weak. A break of the Nov 4 low at CNY8.54 or a low-volume spike-and-fade triggers a downgrade.

Autohome-S
02518.HK / ATHM
Conditional Watch

Facts and status: Q3 revenue and attributable profit fell about 26% and 55%, but the $1.58-per-ADS dividend and buybacks supported ATHM's 12.63% gain. The HK$38.92 Hong Kong quote preceded results.

Confirmation: Hong Kong follows the ADR's positive reaction, holds the Nov 4 close and trades without a material discount.

Risk and invalidation: Advertising, lead generation and vehicle marketplace revenue remain pressured. Failure to follow the ADR or an opening fade triggers a downgrade.

Tongyi
600506.SH
Avoid

Facts and status: The CATL cooperation is a framework with no volume, value or minimum commitment. The stock closed Nov 4 at CNY18.18, down 6.86%, and Q3 alone lost CNY4.88 million.

Confirmation: Reassess only after specific orders, value and delivery terms appear and the stock reclaims CNY18.18.
